scenes.title: Introduction to the War College
scenes.description: The protagonist arrives at the War College, a prestigious military academy that trains the next generation of dragon riders. The atmosphere is tense as students prepare for the challenges ahead.

scenes.title: The First Challenge
scenes.description: Students face their first challenge, a rigorous test of physical and mental endurance. The protagonist struggles but shows resilience, setting the stage for future conflicts.

scenes.title: The Dragon Bonding
scenes.description: The moment when students are paired with their dragons. The protagonist's connection with her dragon is unique, hinting at a deeper bond that will be crucial for their survival.

scenes.title: Rivalries and Alliances
scenes.description: Tensions rise as the protagonist navigates the complex social dynamics of the War College, forming alliances while facing rivalries that threaten her position.

scenes.title: The First Flight
scenes.description: A thrilling scene where the protagonist takes her first flight on her dragon, overcoming her fears and proving her worth to her peers.

scenes.title: The Revelation
scenes.description: A pivotal moment where secrets about the War College's true purpose are revealed, leaving the protagonist questioning everything she thought she knew.

scenes.title: Climactic Battle
scenes.description: The climax of the story where the protagonist and her allies face off against a formidable enemy, testing their skills and resolve in an epic showdown.

scenes.title: Resolution and Growth
scenes.description: The aftermath of the battle leads to personal growth for the protagonist. She reflects on her journey and the bonds formed, setting the stage for future adventures.
